Rooms.Name: The Path to Gragloy Castle
Rooms.Description:
A small dirt path leads you northward. An old rickety #Csign
 #Wis sticking in the ground here.

Rooms.Name: The Path
Rooms.Description:
You are still walking on the dirt path. The castle is in
view but you see nothing else. The grass in this area is
brown, there are no flowers or trees.

Rooms.Name: The Path
Rooms.Description:
A small bridge is northward, bridging an empty moat.
For some strange reason there is no detail around this castle.
You think to yourself that this place is really dreadful.

Rooms.Name: The Entryway
Rooms.Description:
A few old, worn down pieces of lumber form a bridge
enabling for you to cross the small moat around the
castle. The outer courtyard spreads to the east and west.

Rooms.Name: The Outer Courtyard
Rooms.Description:
This is the outer courtyard. Long grasses now grow
here due to lack of care. You can feel many small creatures
crawl over your feet. The wind blowing in the grass creates
haunting, howling sounds. A large boulder can been seen to
the east.

Rooms.Name: The Forgotten Rock
Rooms.Description:
A large boulder lies here in the field. As you look at
it, a question forms in your head, 'How did this get here?'.
You notice small markings on the rock.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The rock has a small symbol carved upon it, which
glows a deep blue color.  It looks like this:

#b                /\
#b              /____\
#b            /\      /\
#b          /____\  /____\
#N

Rooms.Name: The Outer Courtyard
Rooms.Description:
The weeds and flowers that once grew here have been
withered from the horrid weather of this area.  You hear
the crackling sound of snail shells as you walk along
this rugged piece of land.  Bare patches on the ground
indicate that this area has been used by other
adventurers, as a campsite.

Rooms.Name: The Outer Courtyard
Rooms.Description:
Parts of the castle's crumbled walls lie along
this part of the field. A small dirt path lies to the
north.

Rooms.Name: The Hidden Path
Rooms.Description:
A narrow dirt path covered with small rocks leads north
and south here.  Tall stalks of brown grass grow here making
it hard to see around you.  A deep howl of wind blows
giving this place a very eerie effect.

Rooms.Name: The Hidden Path
Rooms.Description:
A narrow dirt path covered with small rocks leads north
and south here.  Tall stalks of brown grass grow here making
it hard to see around you.  A deep howl of wind blows
giving this place a very eerie effect.

Rooms.Name: The Hidden Path
Rooms.Description:
A narrow dirt path covered with small rocks leads north
and south here.  Tall stalks of brown grass grow here making
it hard to see around you.  A turn in the path is visible to
the north.

Rooms.Name: A Turn in the Path
Rooms.Description:
There is a small bend in the path leading you
to the back of the castle.  The long grasses that
grow here caress your hands causing you to pull
yourself closer.

Rooms.Name: The End of the Path
Rooms.Description:
You've reached the end of the path to discover
a small passage in the castle walls, but it is too
dark to see where it leads.

Rooms.Name: The Castle Gates
Rooms.Description:
The power of time has crumbled the castle walls,
and the ground is strewn with chunks of broken stone.
The gates have fallen, and now form piles of large
splinters around your feet. Dead vines twine up parts
of the walls pulling them down even more.

Rooms.Name: The Inner Courtyard
Rooms.Description:
Armors of the warriors who sought to protect this castle
lie along the ground.  Rusted weapons are left in the dirt.
Decaying corpses of unsuccessful adventurers are scattered
throughout the courtyard.

Rooms.Name: The Inner Courtyard
Rooms.Description:
Armors of the warriors who sought to protect this castle
lie along the ground.  Rusted weapons are left in the dirt.
Decaying corpses of unsuccessful adventurers are scattered
throughout the courtyard.

Rooms.Name: The Base of the Eastern Tower
Rooms.Description:
A small opening in the side of the wall leads
into the eastern tower.  The courtyard continues north
and west.

Rooms.Name: The Inner Courtyard
Rooms.Description:
Armors of the warriors who sought to protect this castle
lie along the ground.  Rusted weapons are left in the dirt.
Decaying corpses of unsuccessful adventurers are scattered
throughout the courtyard.

Rooms.Name: The Inner Courtyard
Rooms.Description:
Armors of the warriors who sought to protect this castle
lie along the ground.  Rusted weapons are left in the dirt.
Decaying corpses of unsuccessful adventurers are scattered
throughout the courtyard.

Rooms.Name: The Inner Courtyard
Rooms.Description:
Armors of the warriors who sought to protect this castle
lie along the ground.  Rusted weapons are left in the dirt.
Decaying corpses of unsuccessful adventurers are scattered
throughout the courtyard.

Rooms.Name: The Base of the Western Tower
Rooms.Description:
A small opening in the side of the wall leads
into the western tower.  The courtyard continues north
and east.

Rooms.Name: The Inner Courtyard
Rooms.Description:
Armors of the warriors who sought to protect this castle
lie along the ground.  Rusted weapons are left in the dirt.
Decaying corpses of unsuccessful adventurers are scattered
throughout the courtyard.

Rooms.Name: The Inner Courtyard
Rooms.Description:
Armors of the warriors who sought to protect this castle
lie along the ground.  Rusted weapons are left in the dirt.
Decaying corpses of unsuccessful adventurers are scattered
throughout the courtyard.

Rooms.Name: On the Western Tower Stairs
Rooms.Description:
The stairs seem to be sturdy enough to hold your weight
but you have an uneasy feeling going up these stairs. Small
torches wind up the sides of the walls as do the stairs.

Rooms.Name: The Western Tower Stairs
Rooms.Description:
A small peep of light glints from above.  You must
be near the top of the tower.  A breeze blows in
from the small hatch at the top.

Rooms.Name: The Top of the Western Tower
Rooms.Description:
You take a deep breath as you reach the final stair.
From here you can see for miles in every direction. You can
even see the temple of Midgaard. Your eyes wander across the
landscape trying to find landmarks that you recognize.
You notice a chunk of the tower has broken off.

Rooms.Name: The Fall of the Fool
Rooms.Description:
Ooooooh that's gotta hurt! Walking off of towers
is a dangerous hobby.  Do be more careful next time!
(You're just lucky this wasn't the spot of your death!)

Rooms.Name: On the Eastern Tower Stairs
Rooms.Description:
The stairs seem to be sturdy enough to hold your
weight but you have an uneasy feeling going up these
stairs. Small torches wind up the sides of the walls as
do the stairs.

Rooms.Name: The Eastern Tower Stairs
Rooms.Description:
The rickety stairs make you very nervous.  As you
grab hold of the hand rail a piece of it breaks off.
Decay has befallen these stairs.

Rooms.Name: The Top of the Eastern Tower
Rooms.Description:
A strong gust of wind nearly blows you off the tower.
Lights from villages can be seen in the distance as small
birds fly by your head.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Castle Gragloy
Rooms.Description:
Large pieces of the walls lie across the floor making
it hard for you to move around.  This castle has held
off many invaders... Minotaurs, Drow, even Trolls, but
nothing could have prepared the previous owners for the
Gargoyles.  A staircase leading down is to the east.

Rooms.Name: The Royal Hallway (or what used to be)
Rooms.Description:
The halls of this once glamorous hallway are now
crumbled with age.  The walls used to be lined with
paintings of the former royal families but now the walls
are bare.  A long red carpet also used to stretch from
here to the throne room but instead the carpet you walk
along is made of roots and small shrubs.

Rooms.Name: The Royal Hallway
Rooms.Description:
Statues used to line the sides of this part of the
corridor.  The statues are still there...  But in pieces.
Long vines have grown in the walls and have advanced
their way on to some of the more intact statues. Pieces
of the walls are missing in this segment of the hallway
allowing light to seep in.

Rooms.Name: The Throne Room
Rooms.Description:
Small torches placed in the corners, illuminate
this room, but you wish they hadn't. This has got to be
the most age-stricken room in the castle.  The walls
are cracked, vines have grown over almost everything and
the ceiling has caved in. What used to be a magnificent
throne room is now a disaster area serving the ruler of
the gargoyles. You see the blood of adventurers smeared
on the floors and walls.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to the Dungeon
Rooms.Description:
A small, black door has been bashed open to reveal
the entrance to the dungeon. The smell of death touches
your nostrils causing you to gag. A small set of stairs
lead downward into the dungeon.

Rooms.Name: The Stairs to the Dungeon
Rooms.Description:
You notice some of the stairs are broken or cracked.
As you carefully make your way down the stairs you notice
there is no light source except from the door at the top.
Small rodents crawl around your feet trying not to be noticed.

Rooms.Name: In the Dungeon
Rooms.Description:
The smell of death fully enters your nose as you
enter this room. Torches do line the walls around this
area but they are not lit. Many more rodents race across
the floor here.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Dungeon
Rooms.Description:
The hallways in this dungeon are so dark you can't
make anything out here.  All you can see is darkness.
You hear the squeals of rats as you step on their small
bodies, also, you hear the cracking of the bones of
former guests.

Rooms.Name: Outside the Cells
Rooms.Description:
You can make out some bars to the west, and the
hallway continues to the south. You brush yourself
off as cobwebs get caught on your clothing.

Rooms.Name: Outside the Cells
Rooms.Description:
As you touch along the wall to find your way,
small spiders and bugs crawl up your arm. You
frantically brush them off before they bite you.
A small cell lies to the west.

Rooms.Name: Outside the Cells
Rooms.Description:
You see a glint of light coming from the east
which provides enough light to see another cell to
the south. A medium sized spider hovers down in front
of your face. Confidently, you smack it away.

Rooms.Name: A Dingy Cell
Rooms.Description:
A hint of light escapes from a large crack in the
wall to the east. There is nothing in this room most
likely because the light scared the creatures away from
here. The crack looks just big enough for you to fit
through.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Crack
Rooms.Description:
Light seeps in from the door to the north. You think
to yourself that this once formed part of a catacomb, but
the walls must have caved in from age.

Rooms.Name: The Chamber of the Damned
Rooms.Description:
The light seems to be coming from the walls themselves.
A large pentagram lies in the middle of the floor leading
downwards, though you cannot see what lies within it. Upside
down crosses and other devil-worshipping artifacts fill this
room making you feel strange.

Rooms.Name: The Hole of Fate
Rooms.Description:
Congratulations! You've won an all expenses paid
trip...to Hell! You'll spend what feels like an eternity
there, bathing in nice warm weather, hanging out with all
your old deceased friends, and the best part is you get
to meet the ultimate evil...SATAN!
    You're dead, loser. >:P

Rooms.Name: Inside a Damp Cell
Rooms.Description:
Musty air fills the room as water drips from the
ceiling creating that ever horrifying sound as it echoes
through the hallways of the dungeon. A small pile of bones
sits in the corner covered by cobwebs and rats.

Rooms.Name: Inside a Cell
Rooms.Description:
Small piles of bones lie about on the ground. Rats
creep in and out of the piles sending shivers down your
spine. A small piece of flesh on the ground, infested
with maggots making you want to leave this dank cell.

Rooms.Name: Inside a Rotted Cell
Rooms.Description:
As you enter this room, you decide this is where
that smell of death comes from because there are corpses
wrapped in spider webs spread all around. This is not
one of the best places to stay since there is a gigantic
spider nest here.

Rooms.Name: The War Room
Rooms.Description:
Out of the whole castle this is the only room that
appears to be totally intact.  Paintings of heroes now
forgotten hang on the walls and precious mithril armors
stand at attention along the sides of the room. A long
table lies in the middle of the room, used to plan
strategic battles.  The gargoyles must use this room
frequently.

Rooms.Name: Atop the Staircase
Rooms.Description:
You are at a staircase which leads downwards. A chandelier
engulfed in vines hangs above your head.  Muddy tracks from
gargoyles lead up and down these stairs many times.

Rooms.Name: The Gargoyle's Lodging
Rooms.Description:
This is the place where most of the Gargoyles sleep
and congregate. Torches illuminate the room enough to
see that this is quite a small place.  The blood of
other creatures is splattered all around the walls,
convincing you that they feast extravagantly.

Mobs.Name: gargoyle soldier garg
Mobs.LongDescription: A Gargoyle soldier watches you fiercely.
Mobs.Description:
He's big, tough and mean.  His wingspan is at least 10'
making him look even more mean.

Mobs.Name: gargoyle guard male
Mobs.LongDescription: A gargoyle stands here patroling the castle.
Mobs.Description:
His deep red eyes make you want to back off, it looks
like he doesn't have to answer to anyone.

Mobs.Name: female gargoyle garg
Mobs.LongDescription: A busty gargoyle in torn clothes struts seductively here.
Mobs.Description: She has long black flowing hair, and is very well proportioned.

Mobs.Name: rat osquip
Mobs.LongDescription: A giant six-legged rat creeps around here.
Mobs.Description:
It's ugly, it's big, it's got big teeth, and six legs.
But worst of all it looks hungry.

Mobs.Name: corpse rotting dead undead
Mobs.Description:
Once the body of an unfortunate prisoner, who met his doom,
and is now a blue-faced, rotting corpse.

Mobs.Name: giant tarantula spider
Mobs.LongDescription: A tarantula of immense proportions drops down in front of you.
Mobs.Description:
One of the ugliest tarantulas you've ever seen, with
long black-orange hair, and two big fangs.

Mobs.Name: demona female gargoyle garg
Mobs.LongDescription: Demona, leader of the Gargoyles stands here overlooking her minions.
Mobs.Description:
With fiery red hair, and a dazzling evil grin, Demona,
is a knockout killer.

Mobs.Name: spider tarantula small
Mobs.LongDescription: A hairy tarantula crawls by your feet.
Mobs.Description:
The tarantula is as big as your foot and has eight
eyes looking at you!

Mobs.Name: satan satanic small
Mobs.LongDescription: A little satanic creature tries to claw you!
Mobs.Description:
It looks like the ones you'd find in hell but this
one could give you a thrashing.

Mobs.Name: elder garg gargoyle
Mobs.LongDescription: A wise looking gargoyle sits in the corner.
Mobs.Description:
His scars prove he was once a magnificent warrior.
Now he looks old and frail.  But with age comes wisdom.

Objects.Name: dragon tooth bracer
Objects.Description: A bracer lined with dragon teeth lies here.

Objects.Name: pendant crystal
Objects.Description: A glinting crystal tied to a piece of string lies here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Bright beams of light shoot into your eyes as you gaze
into the center of the crystal.

Objects.Name: magic rock
Objects.Description: A runed rock lies here un-noticed.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you look at the small rock you notice a small symbol:
          /\
        /____\
      /\      /\
    /____\  /____\
Kind of like the one on the rock by Castle Gragloy

Objects.Name: pentagram medallion
Objects.Description: A pentagram on a string is hanging on a hook.
